title: Brevard County Referendum: Renew the Save Our Indian River Lagoon Half-Cent Sales Tax
what_it_does: County ballot question (Yes / No). Passes with a simple majority of votes cast on the question.
ballot_summary: To restore the Indian River Lagoon through infrastructure, capital improvements, and programs… shall Brevard County renew the existing Save Our Indian River Lagoon half-cent sales tax for ten years?
what_yes_means: A YES vote extends the existing half-cent sales tax for ten more years to fund lagoon restoration: septic-to-sewer conversions, muck removal, stormwater treatment and habitat projects; the county estimates roughly $800 million over the renewal period.
what_no_means: A NO vote lets the half-cent lagoon tax, first approved in 2016, expire at the end of its current term, ending that dedicated funding.
verified_ballot_note: Ballot question as reported by WFIT (https://www.wfit.org/podcast/coastal-connection/2026-07-14/irl-sales-tax-referendum-on-the-november-ballot-2026) and Central Florida Public Media (https://www.cfpublic.org/environment/2026-05-19/lagoon-tax-another-ten-years-brevard-voters-decide); the county's program page is https://www.brevardfl.gov/SaveOurIndianRiverLagoon.
